A '''prisoner''' was a member of the [[Brigian]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. He was an [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] until interred in the prison [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Despayre]]. There, he became infamous for [[Death/Legends|killing]] a [[virevol]] with only a stick.
